headline: Enhance CodeClip with AI and User Experience Improvements
summary: Integrate AI-powered code suggestion features to enhance user experience, streamline the organization process, and improve snippet sharing capabilities. Implement a more intuitive interface design based on user feedback.
actions: Implement an AI assistant that suggests relevant code snippets as users type or search for specific keywords, reducing the time needed to find and organize code
Redesign the user interface with a cleaner layout and more efficient navigation options, making it easier for users to manage their code snippets and access fea
Add real-time collaboration tools that allow multiple team members to work on the same project or snippet simultaneously, enhancing productivity and teamwork.
